Dusk at the lakeside camp

Every page is filled!

Stone Age people were clever fishers. They made tools from bone, antler, wood and plants; they knew where and when each fish could be found; and they preserved food to last. Everything they needed came from the land and water around them.

What you found out

  • Bone hook: be patient, and pull at just the right moment.
  • Antler harpoon: barbs stop a fish slipping off, and water bends light, so fish are nearer than they look.
  • Wicker trap: traps catch fish while you do other jobs.
  • Spear by torchlight: light draws fish up to the surface at night.
  • Smoking rack: smoking and drying fish made the catch last for days or weeks.
